title: The Customize your site prompt and every rule fix point where the fix goes for the release's own CMS and template family, and the server reads the theme zip the readers open (theme zips named after the theme's version, with or without wp-)
expect: S1: every test passes, including: every tch path the prompt names exists for every family; a JA Joomla template fix goes to ja-products products/joomlart/*/ja_<name>/source, Tracy Joomla to template-patches, WordPress to tracy-wordpress-theme/overlays/<slug>; a contract fix names its contracts/<slug>/<major> folder; only a template or plugin rule asks for a new release.

S2: every test passes, including: a fix speaks of its own CMS only; no fix names tracy-dev site-pages; REL-2 names the draft branch and site-pages.mjs, and PAGE-1/4/7 give REL-2's fix when the pages file is missing; STAB-1 with no profile row is owned by tracy; STAB-2 slot-only is owned by the contract; NAME-1 quotes a ternary whole.

S3: every test passes, including: the server downloads wp-ja-morgan-1.1.11.zip for release 1.1.12 (the zip the readers open first), tracy-base-1.1.5.zip counts as a theme zip and a plugin zip never does, and a long message is cut between two list items with ', and more', never inside a path.

selectors.zip: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/template-customization-question-readiness/readers/theme-zips.js themeZipsInOrder, themeZipsOfSetting; gallery-cache.js themeZipOf; customize-readiness.js needsWebroot

evidence: 12/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site/ops: ja-morgan/wp7 1.1.12 9/24 and ja-kinetic/wp7 1.0.7 10/25 with 'the release carries no theme zip and no webroot'; WordPress prompts sent theme fixes to ja-products and named vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/SKILL.md (absent); REL-2 named tracy-dev site-pages (unknown command in tracy-dev 0.7.1).
fence: One theme zip order shared by the download and every reader; the prompt's fix place per template family; a static test over every rule fix site per platform
